verdict.rationale: A model card is a fair question for a frontier model provider, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party model card or system card for the current flagship covering capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use. The docs show only API guides and update announcements, and community posts mentioning parameter counts or benchmarks do not amount to a published card.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can read a published model card or system card — capabilities, training approach, evaluation results, and intended use — for the current flagship model
